description: Conviction-ranked orgs for one outcome family. Pass values_profile_id (preferred) and/or outcome. Returns values_filtering + exclusions[] with why-filtered reasons (never silent red-line drops). Does not mix units (ADR 0007 Proposed). Never invents CE. An unknown outcome (for example climate) or an empty result carries coverage: what we don't rate and what to do instead; never a guessed rating.

red_lines.description: Comma-separated cause ids or tags to exclude

values_profile_id.description: Preset id (vp_*). Preferred binding: loads outcome_preference, red_lines, risk, tax, geography from data/values_profiles/{id}.json. Outcome may be omitted when the profile supplies it. Surfaced back as values_filtering.profile_id + exclusions[].
